summary: boardcraft-desktop browse <loopback-port> lists boards through the connected sign-in path. Clicking a UUID-bound Kit button reads that board through EditClient::read_selected_board. The navigation-enabled host resolves the session, checks current catalog access with the shared authorize operation and loads ordered rows in one transaction. Returning to the list requests current visibility without replaying the selection.
evidence: selected_board_read_checks_current_membership passed over loopback HTTP. The non-target second Review returned IDs 73 Sketch and 61 Ink at revision 1. The ordinary host returned 404 for selection; both host modes returned 404 for non-target direct GET/PUT. The hidden private board and the target with a pre-catalog creator grant both returned 403 on the selection route. Removing workspace membership produced HTTP 403 with an empty body while the bearer still resolved; separate session revocation then returned session rejection.

opens_selected_board_by_id passed in a graphical Windows child without database or actor configuration. The mounted buttons were board IDs 203 Quartz, 202 Review, 201 Review in screen order, without hidden or item controls. A pointer click on 201 opened only 73 Sketch above 61 Ink. Back to boards reloaded the list; clicking 202 opened only 62 Outline. Fresh connections at each checkpoint matched the original session verifier/account and both boards' ordered item IDs, titles and revisions.

revoked_membership_blocks_board_selection passed. After list mount, the parent removed only the workspace membership. The stale click showed Destination unavailable with no item, editor or save controls. Back showed No boards. After membership restoration, explicitly clicking Refresh showed the ordered buttons again; another click on 201 reopened Sketch above Ink. Fresh connections confirmed the original session, the three subscriptions, the expected membership at each step and unchanged rows at revision 1.

All 13 windows_smoke cases passed with --test-threads=1. cargo test --locked --workspace passed all 22 tests, including all eight loopback_board_access cases. cargo fmt --all -- --check and git diff --check passed. The worker shell denied node --test scripts/run.test.mjs; runner regressions remain for coordinator verification.

The native duplicate-label selection, denial and explicit recovery match the synthetic reference observations recorded in ROADMAP.md. The graphical navigation cases used configured sessions; browse-specific interactive sign-in, service-fault retry and bearer expiry were not separately exercised in a window. The tests establish GPUI pointer routing and displayed control order, not physical input, browser timing or automatic sidebar refresh.
